import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    w=0.4*p[9]
    return p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*t + (p[3] + p[4]*t + p[5]*np.sin(w*t+p[6]))/P + p[7]*P*np.log(P)+p[8]*np.cos(2*w*t)/P
